name: Procurement Agents
description: Supplier, PO, and sourcing vocabulary + starter questions (IBM ai-agents-in-procurement: supplier evaluation, PO automation, compliance). PO write-back is approval-gated.
starter_prompts: Which suppliers are overdue on delivery commitments this month?
Draft a PO for 500t of isoprene from our approved supplier list
Compare unit prices across suppliers for our top 5 purchased materials

terminology.description: Purchase Order — a formal, approval-gated commitment to buy. In this platform a PO draft is created only via an approved ontology action.
A vendor providing goods/services. Distinct from a 'customer' (who buys from us).
Days from order placement to delivery — the core supplier-performance metric.
Verification that a supplier/PO meets policy (approved vendor list, budget, terms) before commitment.
Qualifying a second supplier for a critical material to de-risk supply.
Agreed invoice settlement conditions (e.g. Net 30). Watch for mismatch vs supplier master data.
